en_title: Denis Villeneuve Praises Human Creativity Over AI Prompts, Almost Announces New Bond
cn_title: 丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦称赞人类创造力胜过AI提示词，差点宣布新邦德人选
opus_summary: 丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦在洛杉矶一场活动上谈及人工智能与艺术创作，强调人类共同创作的过程。他还开玩笑称要公布下一任詹姆斯·邦德人选，随后打住。据报道，罗伯特·帕丁森等演员正在候选之列，但Amazon MGM Studios尚未正式确认。

paragraphs.en: Denis Villeneuve has praised human creativity over AI prompts, and playfully stirred the pot over the increasing rumours and speculation surrounding the casting of the main character in his upcoming James Bond film.
paragraphs.cn: 丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦称赞人类创造力胜过AI提示词，并就围绕他即将推出的詹姆斯·邦德电影主角选角日益增多的传闻和猜测，开玩笑地推波助澜了一番。

paragraphs.en: Addressing the crowd at Saturday night's Art+Film fundraiser at the LACMA museum in Los Angeles where he was being honored for his contributions to cinema (thanks, THR ), the Dune: Part Three director took the opportunity to praise his heroes including Steven Spielberg and James Cameron, before speaking to the existential crisis currently being suffered by artists as a result of the rise of artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.cn: 在周六晚于洛杉矶LACMA博物馆举行的Art+Film筹款活动上，这位《沙丘3》导演因对电影的贡献而受到表彰，并向现场观众发表讲话（感谢THR）。他借此机会称赞了包括史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格和詹姆斯·卡梅隆在内的偶像，随后谈到了艺术家目前因人工智能的兴起而遭遇的生存危机。

paragraphs.en: "At the heart of every one of my films, there’s a question I need to answer," said Villeneuve. "The audience may see it or they may not, and that is fine. For me, each film is a statement to the unknown to try and find that answer. Perhaps those questions are more urgent now than ever."
paragraphs.cn: 维伦纽瓦说：「我的每一部电影的核心，都有一个我需要回答的问题。观众可能看得出来，也可能看不出来，这都没关系。对我来说，每部电影都是一次面向未知的表达，试图找到那个答案。或许如今那些问题比以往任何时候都更为迫切。」

paragraphs.en: "We are at the crossroad, asking what defines a human being and what human expression is worth? Every parent on Earth is a little worried about the world of our children will inherit. That question is at the heart of Dune: Part Three with Paul and Chani fighting to give their children a better world than the one they were given.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们正处在十字路口，追问是什么定义了人类，以及人类表达的价值是什么？地球上的每一位父母都对我们的孩子将继承的世界有些担忧。这个问题正是《沙丘3》的核心：保罗和契妮为让孩子们拥有一个比他们自己所得到的更好的世界而奋斗。」

paragraphs.en: The director went on to discuss the vital role that human creativity plays in the process of creating art.
paragraphs.cn: 这位导演接着谈到了人类创造力在艺术创作过程中所发挥的重要作用。

paragraphs.en: “For a filmmaker today, it is very real," said Villeneuve. "I have a choice. I can create something with a prompt or I can go into the desert with actors, with a crew and go on a real adventure where I learn about life and become better at my craft. Those are two different things. Well, I know there’s producers in the room and they will say that one is more expensive than the other. More important than the result is the process. The process is how the human experience acquires its meaning. In this moment in time, it is more important than ever that human beings keep making art together. That is the heritage I want to give to my children.”
paragraphs.cn: 维伦纽瓦说：「对今天的电影人来说，这非常现实。我有一个选择。我可以用一条提示词创作出一些东西，也可以和演员、摄制组一起走进沙漠，展开一次真正的冒险，在其中了解生活，让自己的技艺变得更好。这是两回事。嗯，我知道现场有制片人，他们会说其中一种比另一种更贵。比结果更重要的是过程。过程使人类的经历获得意义。在这个时刻，人类继续共同创作艺术比以往任何时候都更重要。这就是我想留给孩子们的遗产。」

paragraphs.en: On a more lighthearted note, Villeneuve closed his speech by referencing the growing hype surrounding the casting of the next James Bond. Playing up to the headlines, Villeneuve said, "To express my gratitude with the blessing of my new friends at Amazon, I will reveal to you tonight who will be the next James Bond. The new James Bond is… and I will stop right now because Amy Pascal is about to have a heart attack. Thank you very much.”
paragraphs.cn: 在较为轻松的气氛中，维伦纽瓦以谈及围绕下一任詹姆斯·邦德选角日益高涨的关注结束了演讲。维伦纽瓦迎合着新闻热议说道：「为了表达我的感谢，并且得到了我在亚马逊的新朋友们的首肯，我今晚将向你们揭晓谁会是下一任詹姆斯·邦德。新的詹姆斯·邦德是……我现在就打住，因为艾米·帕斯卡尔快要心脏病发作了。非常感谢。」

paragraphs.en: Just last week it was reported that The Batman's Robert Pattinson had screen-tested for the role of 007 in the 26th James Bond film , and that Superman's Nicholas Hoult had also come into consideration. The two join Jack Lowden, Callum Turner, and Josh O'Connor on the shortlist for the hotly-contested role , although nothing official has been confirmed by Amazon MGM Studios.
paragraphs.cn: 就在上周，有报道称《新蝙蝠侠》的罗伯特·帕丁森已经为第26部詹姆斯·邦德电影中的007一角试镜，《超人》的尼古拉斯·霍尔特也被纳入考虑范围。两人与杰克·劳登、卡勒姆·特纳和乔什·奥康纳一同入围了这个竞争激烈的角色的候选名单，不过亚马逊米高梅影业尚未正式确认任何消息。

paragraphs.en: Casting for James Bond has been underway since spring, and since then rumours about who will take the role of the British super spy have been flying around from all angles like misfiring gadgets in Q Branch. Slow Horses' Jack Lowden would appear to be the frontrunner at least based on the feedback from fans, although former Bond Daniel Craig appears to be rooting for Josh O'Connor .
paragraphs.cn: 詹姆斯·邦德的选角工作自春季以来一直在进行，此后，关于谁将出演这位英国超级间谍的传闻便从四面八方满天飞，宛如Q部门里失灵的装备。至少从粉丝的反馈来看，《流人》的杰克·劳登似乎是领跑者，不过前邦德演员丹尼尔·克雷格似乎在支持乔什·奥康纳。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three is set to arrive in theaters on December 18, 2026. Also arriving in theaters around that time are three Dune: Part Three popcorn buckets, including one with two sandworm mouths. Watch those teeth.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，维伦纽瓦的《沙丘3》定于2026年12月18日在影院上映。大约在同一时间，三款《沙丘3》爆米花桶也将登陆影院，其中一款有两张沙虫的嘴。小心那些牙齿。
